data.title: 拉毗 · 休闲起居室沙发电影之夜的并肩小憩
data.description: 深夜的前哨基地起居室内，拉毗身穿舒适的宽大白衬衫与休闲短裤，与你并肩陷入柔软的布艺大沙发中。怀中抱着一桶刚爆好的香甜爆米花，侧过头看向你，向来严谨认真的神色在电影的柔光中彻底放松，肩膀悄悄向你轻靠。
data.location: 前哨基地私人起居室布艺沙发
data.action: 并肩靠坐在沙发上捧着爆米花桶看电影，神情放松依赖
data.lighting: 电视屏幕微弱的光影起伏与茶几柔暖台灯
promptTokens: long brown hair loose over shoulder
data.promptProse: Curled beside the viewer on the living room sofa during a late-night movie, she holds a large bowl of buttered popcorn. The dim glow of the screen reflects in her softening scarlet eyes as her posture eases into quiet, comfortable warmth.
data.animaCaption: She sits on the couch sharing popcorn during a movie, leaning gently toward the viewer in the soft tv light.
